title: Telegraph ruler danger and explain the decisive loss
description: D14, F22; expected +4 points (2 to 4 each). The critique-v2 novice has ruler losses at 46 and 97 seconds versus AI5 while AI-only rulers stay covered. Add a directional incoming cue and a cause-specific end-screen account, with fast retry. UI/render lane: src/main.js, src/ui/hud.js, src/ui/flow.js, src/ui/menu-draw.js, src/ui/i18n.js, src/audio/sfx.js, src/render/fx.js. Player lane: src/player/feel.js as needed. Use existing public events; coordinate contracts with the orchestrator. Acceptance: replay novice AI5 seed6; show a warning before impact and the actual ruler-death cause, weapon/bearing/time on the end screen; every defeat in the 30-seed novice cohort has one causal sentence; retry preserves setup in one action. Evidence: research/19-gameplay-critique-v2.md and tests/evidence/critique-v2/.

title: Make existing reload alternatives visible and consequential
description: A2, A4, E18; expected +3 points. The embodied novice records 3.21/3.54/3.67 locally reachable useful command types per reload at AI2/5/8, but exercises only 0.83/0.94/0.97 distinct non-aim types; repair dominates. This is a discovery and consequence problem, not a need for more bindings. UI/render lane: src/main.js, src/ui/hud.js, src/ui/overlay.js. Player lane: src/player/interact.js, src/progression.js. Sim/npc/ai/tuning lane: src/npc/jobs.js and src/tuning.js only if paired policy ablation shows priorities have no useful consequence. Acceptance: preserve at least two locally reachable non-aim alternatives after first damage; in three human five-reload sessions, at least two players identify repair, building/replacement and personal safety without external instructions, choose at least two distinct non-aim intervention types across the session, and explain the resulting trade-off. Verify a visible repair/rebuild result and a real cost or exposure trade-off; do not reward redundant command spam or force actions when no intervention is needed. Retain one contextual prompt. Evidence: research/19, scripts/novice.mjs, tests/evidence/critique-v2/novice-embodied.json.

title: Restore measured ruler and morale endings without early blowouts
description: E20, E19; expected +3 points. Wave1 and independent forest evidence are palace-only; ruler target eligibility is filtered out after the 120-second breach switch, and morale remains far above 10. Sim/npc/ai/tuning lane: src/ai/controller.js, src/ai/targets.js, src/npc/morale.js, src/sim/rules.js, src/tuning.js. UI/render: src/main.js, src/ui/overlay.js, src/ui/i18n.js for corresponding pressure warnings. Acceptance: at least 20 independent seeds with paired slot orders at AI5; ruler and surrender endings each 10-30%, no restoration of sub-eight-minute AI-only blowouts, at least 80% finish in 12-20 minutes; show exposure duration and 45-second morale-clock crossings. Keep all cover rules shared with humans. Use research/19 counterfactuals as candidates, not claimed validated tuning. Measured candidate, not a shipped repair: rulerDangerM 10 to 4 plus surrenderPopFrac 0.25 to 0.35 gives 5 palace/3 ruler/2 surrender in 10 independent seeds, minimum 454.4s, but only 7/10 remain in 12-20min. Radius 0 gives 10/10 ruler endings and must not be treated as variety. Retest at 20 independent paired seeds and reconcile the pacing gate. Baseline morale minima 44.59 versus surrender 10; threshold 55 sustained 45s qualifies 3/20 baseline worlds in an offline first-ending counterfactual, but conflicts with the current Steady work band. Keep causal UI and intentional target selection in scope.

title: Calibrate pacing and AI competence across levels and shipped duel maps
description: B6, F21; expected +3 points (B6 2 to 4, F21 2 to 3). Independent evidence: AI3 forest times out 16/20 and has a 707.5s loaded/crewed/funded silence; ice-duel times out 8/10. The embodied novice finishes only 2/10 AI5 matches in 12-20min and can lose its ruler in 46s. Desert/volcano also have unarmed starter castles, separately tracked in castle-game-uo7.16. Sim/npc/ai/tuning lane: src/ai/controller.js, src/ai/targets.js, src/ai/build.js, src/npc/brain.js, src/npc/jobs.js, src/tuning.js. Coordinate cardinal/recovery planning with castle-game-er7 and armed starts with uo7.16. Acceptance: rerun the 60-match equal-level matrix, unequal levels in both physical orientations, and at least 10 independent seeds per biome; each castle fires a first paid shot within 90s and never has an unexplained actual firing gap above 120s or ready gap above 90s. Report crew/ammo/mount reasons for every longer gap, even when readiness never becomes true. Fewer than 10% timeouts; at least 80% of AI5 matches in 12-20min, including the legal novice and map checks, with no return of early ruler blowouts. See research/19 and tests/evidence/critique-v2/analysis.json.

title: Teach local triage and expose the reason an idle gun cannot fire
description: C9, C10, D15; expected +3 points. E auto-crew and the tier ramp exist; human discovery and gun-stall diagnosis remain unproven. UI/render lane: src/main.js, src/ui/hud.js, src/ui/overlay.js, src/ui/i18n.js. Player lane: src/player/interact.js, src/progression.js. Acceptance: a reticle on each stalled own gun distinguishes missing crew, ammunition, funds and obstruction; one first-damage cue leads to a legal reachable action. Run three unbriefed first-match users: at least two finish, first enemy hit under four minutes, and all three can explain why a deliberately stalled gun will not fire. Retain one prompt and current gradual feature gates. Complements existing castle-game-me0 visual acceptance; does not replace or close it. Evidence: research/19 and critique-v2 screenshots.

title: Ensure a match-1 player can fire on every offered duel map
description: C9; expected +1 point, shared with the broader onboarding work (do not double-count). Independent loadout audit: desert-duel west/orig-19 and volcano-duel west/orig-67 start with zero weapons. Match1 disables G/weapon placement, so those offered player starts cannot acquire or fire a gun. Their AIs also have no initial weapon blueprint to replace. Sim/content lane: src/plugins/maps/desert-duel.sim.js, src/plugins/maps/volcano-duel.sim.js, the corresponding generated castle definitions and scripts/rip/castles_to_defs.py as appropriate; coordinate generated content with its owner. Player lane: src/progression.js and setup eligibility only if needed. Prefer an armed, reachable starter loadout over exposing additional controls. Acceptance: boot profile0 in slot0 on all four duel maps; each has an immediately usable or clearly recoverable cannon and reaches a paid shot through real E/Space controls within 90 seconds on a scripted route, with G still hidden. Verify every initial gun and crew route. Re-run map sweeps and preserve distinct castle geometry. Evidence: tests/evidence/critique-v2/map-loadouts.json and research/19-gameplay-critique-v2.md.
